control._why: Board wipes and cheap creature removal have few targets. Brings in discard, an extra counter and more threats that win long games.

midrange._why: More spot removal, and Torpor Orb stops creatures' enter-the-battlefield value. Cuts the slow Jace combo card and a narrow counter.

aggro._why: More cheap answers for early threats. Cuts the slow Jace combo card.

graveyard._why: Added 2026-11-26: their best against graveyard-based aggro decks (graveyard hate, cards that stop enter triggers, cheap removal, sweepers). Torpor Orb stops enter triggers, Ghost Vacuum eats graveyards, more cheap answers. Engineered Explosives stays out: Forge's AI can't use it.
